item.title: 🟠 Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
A flaw in Broadcom's Wi-Fi setup software lets an attacker within radio range run code as root on Broadcom-based routers, without the network password or any pairing step, security researcher Quentin Kaiser disclosed on October 16. He showed the attack working against home gateways supplied by three Belgian internet providers, in one case reading the Wi-Fi password off the device

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 5h

item.title: 🔵 OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — review monitoring and incident-response readiness.
An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said. item.title: 🔵 Sponsored: Agents don’t care about human ideas of right and wrong
item.description:
Why this matters: Potentially urgent issue — confirm whether your environment is exposed.
In this Risky Business sponsored interview James Wilson chats with Sondera co-founder and CEO, Josh Devon, about how AI agents are highly capable, but they’re not the best rule followers or decision makers. The pair find themselves in the philosophical weeds about why agents lack the ability to determine, or care about, right from wrong before getting into how Sondera’s Auto Formulization, that gives specific behaviour guardrails to agents, can help.

Source: Risky Business News  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 13h
